assertion_analysis.condition_for_failure: Setup assertions fail if the temporary file still exists, declared content differs from delivered, or the cited union no longer contains the transient path; these establish the Git-history preconditions rather than claim production coverage.
Restore union-only scope accounting and promotion raises CrewError on temporary.html instead of returning an empty acceptance list; negative-control.log records this failure.
The independent Git diff must be empty for restored draft.html and the cited union must contain it; either assertion fails if fixture history or union accounting changes.
Restore union-only accounting and promotion raises on the restored draft.html; negative-control.log records this failure.
Allow a surviving undeclared edit or misreport the charged path and the raises expectation or diagnostic membership fails.
Replace the net-diff read with head existence filtering and the deleted undeclared file is excused, so the required CrewError is absent.
Swallow an unreadable-base error and return no paths or retain the union silently; the specific cannot-measure CrewError expectation fails.
Treat a missing base as an empty surviving set and the undeclared surviving edit is admitted, so the required refusal is absent.
The Git diff must actually contain imported.html, independently proving the merge fixture has imported content; charging the cited merge in the union also violates the exact declared-only tuple.
Replace the intersection with the base-to-head span alone and imported.html is charged, causing refusal instead of an empty acceptance list.
